categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precious metal catalysts, catalytic application technologies, and recycling and reprocessing of waste precious metal catalysts. It also develops non-precious metal catalysts and provides catalytic application technical services. The business covers catalyst sales, catalyst processing, and catalytic technology services, serving industries such as fine chemicals, basic chemicals, environmental protection, and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in multi-phase and homogeneous catalyst preparation, including mesoporous carrier design, active component dispersion, ligand design, and catalyst activation. It has developed catalytic synthesis technologies such as catalytic reduction, hydrogenolysis, coupling, and catalytic oxidation. The company also leads in precious metal recovery and purification technologies, continuous catalytic reaction technologies, and environmentally friendly catalytic oxidation processes. Production involves advanced equipment and processes from lab-scale to industrial-scale manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the pharmaceutical, chemical new materials, pesticide, dye and pigment, chlor-alkali, environmental protection, and new energy sectors. The company serves nearly a thousand downstream customers, including over a hundred listed companies, focusing on high-end catalyst applications in fine chemicals and expanding into basic chemicals and environmental markets. It also targets emerging markets such as hydrogen fuel cells and organic liquid hydrogen storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and production facilities in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and subsidiaries in other Chinese regions such as Tongchuan and Binzhou. It has begun expanding its international market presence through an international business department and overseas market development efforts.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain: upstream in precious metal raw material recovery and recycling, midstream in catalyst manufacturing and processing, and downstream in providing catalytic application technology services. It integrates the full chain from catalyst materials, technology development, recycling, to environmental treatment solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development focusing on green, efficient, and sustainable catalytic technologies. R&D emphasizes reducing precious metal content while maintaining performance, developing non-precious metal catalysts, advancing continuous catalytic processes, and expanding applications in hydrogen energy and environmental catalysis. The company invests heavily in new product development, technology platform construction, and collaboration with universities and research institutes to accelerate industrialization and market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of catalyst products, catalyst processing services (including toll processing with customer-supplied or company-advanced precious metals), and fees from catalytic application technology development and consulting services. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and technology leader in the precious metal catalyst sector within China's fine chemical industry. It competes with international catalyst manufacturers and is recognized for its strong R&D capabilities, broad product portfolio, and ability to replace imported high-end catalysts. It is expanding into non-precious metal catalysts and new energy sectors to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.785 billion, a 5.15% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 112.88 million, down 48.95%. Despite profit decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.53 billion and equity attributable to shareholders near RMB 988 million, reflecting a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high-performance catalyst products with broad application coverage, and integrated catalytic solutions including catalyst recycling and environmental treatment. It differentiates through advanced catalyst preparation techniques, continuous process technologies, and customized catalytic application services. Its products offer high activity, selectivity, stability, and cost-effectiveness, supporting green and sustainable chemical production and addressing critical industry bottlenecks and import dependencies.
